page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number 510 at top left. Main text in one column, with marginal notes in the left margin (italic marginal notes beside the first paragraphs, and a note "Regerius" beside the later lines). Below the text no notes.

main_text.p: Ludovici Aquitaniæ Regis copiis auxio, pro domitus eft. VENETIS adhuc præfuit Dominicus Monarchus.
main_text.head: In BRITANNIA præfuit CANTIA
main_text.p: Sped in Hiftor. Anglica.Egbertus ufurpator, cui polliquam Ceonulfus Merciorum Rex, capto oculos eruit, & ... nus abfcidit, facelli * Ceturæ. Apud CIDENTALES SAXONAS fuit ... cui. Apud MORTIMBROS, ... thelredo, fuit interregnum; quod tandem diuravit, donec illud Egbertus Wellius occupavit, quod anno DCCCXXVII ... Apud MERCIOS excepit Offa ... Cenulphus coronatus. Intra hoc tempus, ... Regerius.mane seu Dani, irruptiones in Angliam facere ... eum crudeliter vastarunt, sed omnes in ea expe- ditione perisse dicuntur.
In GALLIA multa fiorvit, ... Austrasiæ juvenibus Procerum ... ... Aquitaniæ ... ... ... Patris ... Pippinus ... Bavaria ... Dux pulsus ... (quæ cum ad Anselmum ... ) 1910.

page.notes: Much of the page is faded and blurred, especially in the Gallia paragraph and the lower lines; those passages are only partly legible and are shown with ellipses where I could not read the words with confidence. Marginal note letters are partly illegible.
